description: This file contains a combination of SwiftUI view controller management, network transport implementation for chat sessions, and external interaction handlers for a macOS chat application named OpenClaw. It includes transport logic via GatewayConnection, window/UI management for chat interfaces, and logging setup.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: Manages the presentation and window control logic for the chat interface, including showing, closing, and anchoring the chat window in various modes.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session key asynchronously.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Fetches a list of available chat models asynchronously, with error handling.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Sends a request to abort a specific chat run session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets or updates the model for a specific session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Updates the thinking level for a session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message within a chat session, with optional thinking indication.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the transport connection.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session on the server.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Cleans up or compacts session data on the server.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Return an AsyncStream of transport events for real-time updates.

methods.name: mapPushToTransportEvent
methods.description: Converts a push notification into an internal transport event.
